name: Lasagna for Two
source:
Lasagna for Two is a dating sim perfect for fans of Garfield, romantic comedy, and the '80s. This game is centered around the lovable, unlucky-in-love Jon Arbuckle, as he looks for love while working as a cartoonist and living with his beloved pet cat, Garfield.

[From [url=https://tinyclowngames.itch.io/lasagna-for-two]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《两人烤宽面条》是一款约会模拟游戏，非常适合加菲猫、浪漫喜剧和80年代的粉丝。这款游戏以可爱但爱情不幸的乔恩·阿巴克尔 (Jon Arbuckle) 为中心，他在担任漫画家并与他心爱的宠物猫加菲猫一起生活的同时寻找爱情。

[来自[url=https://tinyclowngames.itch.io/lasagna-for-two]itch.io[/url]]
